mapper.select: SELECT routine_id, user_id, time_type, created_at, updated_at FROM USER_ROUTINE WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY FIELD(time_type, 'MORNING', 'EVENING')
SELECT routine_id, user_id, time_type, created_at, updated_at FROM USER_ROUTINE WHERE routine_id = #{routineId}
SELECT routine_id, user_id, time_type, created_at, updated_at FROM USER_ROUTINE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND time_type = #{type}

SELECT i.item_id, i.routine_id, r.user_id, i.item_name, i.description, i.step_order, i.is_ai_recommended, COALESCE(c.is_completed, 0) AS is_completed, i.deleted_at, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM ROUTINE_ITEM i JOIN USER_ROUTINE r ON r.routine_id = i.routine_id LEFT JOIN ROUTINE_ITEM_COMPLETION c ON c.item_id = i.item_id AND c.completion_date = #{date} WHERE i.routine_id = #{routineId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.step_order, i.item_id

SELECT i.item_id, i.routine_id, r.user_id, i.item_name, i.description, i.step_order, i.is_ai_recommended, 0 AS is_completed, i.deleted_at, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM ROUTINE_ITEM i JOIN USER_ROUTINE r ON r.routine_id = i.routine_id WHERE i.routine_id = #{routineId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.step_order, i.item_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ROUTINE_ITEM (routine_id, item_name, description, step_order, is_ai_recommended) VALUES (#{routineId}, #{name}, #{detail}, #{stepOrder}, #{aiRecommended})
mapper.update: UPDATE ROUTINE_ITEM SET item_name = #{name}, description = #{detail} WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE ROUTINE_ITEM SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE ROUTINE_ITEM SET step_order = #{stepOrder} WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
UPDATE ROUTINE_ITEM SET step_order = #{stepOrder} WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ROUTINE_ITEM_COMPLETION (item_id, completion_date, is_completed) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{date}, #{completed}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_completed = VALUES(is_completed)
